title: Privacy Policy
metaDescription: How Diba Gallery collects, uses, and protects your personal data.

hero.title: Privacy policy
hero.subtitle: We respect your data and explain clearly how we use it when you shop or browse with us.

blocks.heading: Information we collect
blocks.lead: When you create an account, place an order, or subscribe to our newsletter, we may collect:
paragraphs: Name, email address, phone number, and delivery address
Order history and payment confirmation details (we do not store full card numbers)
Device and browsing data to improve site performance and security

blocks.heading: How we use your data
paragraphs: To fulfil orders, provide customer support, and send service-related updates
To personalise recommendations when you opt in to marketing
To comply with legal obligations and prevent fraud
